text:
Riley: Quick idea 0pm gingerbread bake-off in the kitchen tomorrow? 3 categories: structure, taste, and most chaotic decoration. Winner gets the coveted 'Golden Spatula' sticker. :gingerbread_man: :tada:
Marcus: I'm bringing my A-game and questionable royal icing skills. Also, can we use the office mixer or should I BYO?
Eva: Office mixer is fine. I'll bring extra sprinkles and emergency toothpicks. Also starting a tiny judging panel  emoji reactions decide winners (most :heart:, most :laughing:, most :scream:).
James: Love this. I'm terrible at baking but great at eating. Count me in as a judge/consumer. :fork_and_knife:
Tara: Can we do a 'mystery ingredient' twist? Or is that cruel? :thinking:
Riley: Mystery ingredient = marshmallows. Not cruel, just sticky. Also quick poll: react :one: for 6pm, :two: for 7pm, :three: for split sessions (6 & 7). @here
Marcus: :two: 7pm works better for me.
Eva: :one: prefer 6 so I can go home to finish my novel.
HolidayBot: HolidayBot: Reminder  Holiday potluck signup is live. Office closes at 3pm on Dec 23. If you need after-hours access, submit a ticket. :calendar:
Riley: Also starting kudos thread: shoutouts for the quarter go here. I'll start: Tara for landing the partnership with Lantern, Marcus for the infra triage on Friday, and Eva for the docs cleanup.
Tara: Thanks! Huge thanks to James for helping with the demo rehearsal last week.
James: Anytime. See you all tomorrow  expect competitive icing.
Marcus: Prize suggestion: loser has to wear a chef hat to the next all-hands.
Eva: Deal. I'll make name tags so mugs don't get mixed up. Photos appreciated but optional.
Riley: Locked  may the best (or luckiest) gingerbread win. :crown:
(reacts: Riley :tada:, Marcus :cookie:, Eva :sparkles:)
